MAINTENANCE — Maintenance Schedule
MA-5

SCHEDULE B (Cont'd)

System: CHASSIS

Maintenance items:
Steering linkage
Steering gear box
Ball joints and dust covers
Automatic transmission fluid level, oil (E)
and differential fluid level, oil (A)
Brake lines and hoses (F)
Steering gear housing oil (4)
Brake and clutch pedal play (5)

Maintenance interval for scheduled maintenance (000's km) and months, whichever comes first:
N x 1,000: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45
Months: 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 54

Maintenance to be performed at the same:
Every 24 months
I: First period, 10 years
After that, every 2 years: I, I, I, I, I, I, I, I, I
Every 24 months: I, I, I, I, I, I, I, I, I
Every 24 months: I, -, I, -, I, -, I, -, I
Every 24 months: R, -, R, -, R, -, R, -, R
Every 48 months: I, -, -, -, I, -, -, -, I
Every 24 months: I, I, I, I, I, I, I, I, I

See Page Item No.: MA-10 (16), MA-10 (17), MA-11 (19), MA-11 (20), MA-11 (20), MA-11 (20), MA-11 (18), MA-12 (22)

NOTE: * MA is manufacturer's recommendation of items and intervals to ensure optimum overall performance of the vehicle. (A) See Item No. 7 on Page MA-10 with the owner's guide for the warranty booklet, (***) Use same conditions for the engine control system. The warranty period is in accordance with the owner's note.
(1) Prelubricate inspection of upper and system.
(2) Check for oil leaks at automatic transmission.
(3) Check for oil leaks.
(4) Check for oil leak from steering gear box.
(5) The acceptable pedal and stroke below.
(6) Adjust if out of adjustment.
* Refer to nearest member to cross body.
